name: I'd Lowkey Simp for that Bussin Femboy at Work
source:
A new job with new opportunities... 💦

​Though the assignment won't be easy. Being a proper simp takes dedication and hard work. Make sure to give it 110% and the reward will be well worth the effort.

It's risky though, HR and floor managers lurking about, but perhaps an opening will present itself. 🍑

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3473020/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一份新工作，伴随着全新的艳遇良机……💦

不过这桩差事可绝不轻松——要想当好一名合格的舔狗，必须拿出十足的奉献精神与辛勤汗水。务必要付出110%的努力，而最终的奖赏也绝对值得你为此拼尽全力。

当然风险也少不了，人事部与楼层经理正随时在四周巡视盯梢；不过说不定，绝佳的可乘之机很快就会主动送上门来。🍑

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3473020/]Steam[/url]]
